## Home

- New rows above Ready to Play, with the same cards, shown only when they have games:
  - **Pinned:** your pinned games, in their pinned order.
  - **New on Your PC:** games that turned up on your PC in the last 14 days, newest first. Starlight notes when it first sees each game; the games already on your PC when you install this version don't count as new.
- Pinned games no longer carry a pin badge on their covers, and Ready to Play lists games by name instead of putting the pinned ones first.
- All rows work with the controller.
